summary: Re-review of the S2 remediation round 3 at 54aa79e3. All three routed adversarial findings are fixed by fde3eda2 and verified live. The helpers now use the TypeScript 6.0.3 tokenizer (ts.createSourceFile, comment ranges from token trivia, ScriptKind per extension). My direct node check drives the exact committed helper code over 80 assertions: CRLF trailing // disable-line and CRLF // disable-next-line strip and the stripped copies surface no-unused-vars (live oxlint probes, F1r3 closed), an in-string /* above a real disable no longer swallows code (the strip blanks only the real comment range with equal-length spaces, the copy surfaces the finding with no parse error, F2r3 closed), disable text in a string and in a template never counts (F3r3 closed for the forms the plan claims), mid-line and multi-line blocks in both spellings, rule lists, -- reason, the .tsx JSX {/* eslint-disable */} wrap, and a // line inside a block comment count once. The text prefilter is complete: I probed live every case and spacing variant oxlint honors (lowercase eslint and oxlint in both comment styles, the tight //eslint-disable-line form); oxlint rejects the uppercase, mixed-case, and spaced forms, so no honored spelling escapes the prefilter. No case weakened in fde3eda2: the diff touches only the helper zone and its callers, no it( or expect( line changed, and adv 1 to 12 pass as written (S2 adversarial 12 pass). The fixture matches the tree exactly: my independent recheck with the committed tokenizer gives 49 carriers against 49 entries with zero unlisted, stale, kind, count, or blanket mismatches. Every plan and log claim since f617412f re-verified in a detached worktree at 54aa79e3: S2 adversarial 12 pass, S2 oxlint 7 pass, S1 adversarial 7 pass, S1 vinext 1.x 11 pass, npx tsc --noEmit exit 0, full scripts suite 60 pass with only the pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints row. Three new Nits and one Major process gap recorded; none blocks. The Major: fde3eda2 adds `import * as ts from 'typescript'` to the test file although test-strategy section 5 forbids that import ('S3 removes the package'), and no plan or log line records the deviation; the S3 contract itself contradicts the rule's premise ('the kept typescript package uses 7.0.2'), so the strategy role must reconcile. My r3 F8 is resolved by this round (both latent guard weaknesses fixed and live-proven). F4 stays for the S2 closeout.

No plan or log line records this as a deviation, and the rule's premise conflicts with the plan's own S3 contract ('the kept `typescript` package uses 7.0.2', plan line 342), so the rule and the plan contradict each other before this commit. If S3 removes the package per section 5, every scripts test fails at import (61 tests, loud, not silent); if S3 keeps the package at 7.0.2, the import survives only if that release keeps the ts.createSourceFile comment-range API. Rationale: the plan's precedent for superseded strategy rows (plan line 331: 'The strategy role owns the revision') requires a plan record of the supersede; this round made the change without the record. Default disposition: record the deviation in the S2 remediation sub-box at closeout, and have the S3 refresh revise section 5 or the S3 contract so they agree before the S3 Red.

F10 [Nit] review-a: the helper comment at scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:920-921 claims 'Trivia scanning treats strings, templates, and JSX text as non-comment tokens, so disable text inside them never counts (F3r3)', and the Green r7 handoff (jr-green-s2-r7-1bd26b91.log line 14) repeats 'strings, templates, and JSX text never count'. The claim is false for JSX text: my direct check shows ts.getLeadingCommentRanges and ts.getTrailingCommentRanges re-scan JSX text with the standard scanner, so '
// eslint-disable-next-line
' counts as a next-line directive and '
/* eslint-disable */
' counts as a block (s2-jsx-debug.mjs, s2-tokenizer-edge-check.mjs). The plan sub-box line is accurate because it claims only strings and templates. Rationale: conservative over-count, the same accepted direction as F3r3; oxlint fires react(jsx-no-comment-textnodes) instead of honoring the text (live probe exit 1), nothing hides, and the fixture recheck proves no tracked file holds the form (49 carriers against 49 entries). Default disposition: correct the comment and the handoff wording at the next remediation touch; no behavior change.

F11 [Nit] review-a: directiveKindsOfFile classifies on the whole comment text (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:1062-1069), so a blanket /* eslint-disable block whose body contains the literal text 'disable-next-line' (or 'disable-line') is labeled 'next-line' (or 'trailing') and blanketBlocks stays 0. Verified by direct node check: the block-with-line-inside form returns kinds ['next-line'], blocks 0, total 1. Rationale: the directive count and the strip stay correct, so every hidden fault still surfaces in the sweep copy and the unrecorded-sweep check fires; only the recorded kind label can misreport, and no tracked carrier holds the form (all 49 fixture kinds match). Default disposition: accept as a conservative label gap, or classify on the directive head at the next remediation round.
